verses.ar: «وَأَمَّا ٱلْآنَ فَقَدْ ضَحِكَ عَلَيَّ أَصَاغِرِي أَيَّامًا، ٱلَّذِينَ كُنْتُ أَسْتَنْكِفُ مِنْ أَنْ أَجْعَلَ آبَاءَهُمْ مَعَ كِلَابِ غَنَمِي.
verses.kjv: But now [they that are] younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock.
verses.web: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs.

verses.ar: قُوَّةُ أَيْدِيهِمْ أَيْضًا مَا هِيَ لِي. فِيهِمْ عَجِزَتِ ٱلشَّيْخُوخَةُ.
verses.kjv: Yea, whereto [might] the strength of their hands [profit] me, in whom old age was perished?
verses.web: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?

verses.ar: فِي ٱلْعَوَزِ وَٱلْمَحْلِ مَهْزُولُونَ، عَارِقُونَ ٱلْيَابِسَةَ ٱلَّتِي هِيَ مُنْذُ أَمْسِ خَرَابٌ وَخَرِبَةٌ.
verses.kjv: For want and famine [they were] solitary; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste.
verses.web: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَقْطِفُونَ ٱلْمَلَّاحَ عِنْدَ ٱلشِّيحِ، وَأُصُولُ ٱلرَّتَمِ خُبْزُهُمْ.
verses.kjv: Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots [for] their meat.
verses.web: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom tree are their food.

verses.ar: مِنَ ٱلْوَسَطِ يُطْرَدُونَ. يَصِيحُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ كَمَا عَلَى لِصٍّ.
verses.kjv: They were driven forth from among [men], (they cried after them as [after] a thief;)
verses.web: They are driven out from among men. They cry after them as after a thief,

verses.ar: لِلسَّكَنِ فِي أَوْدِيَةٍ مُرْعِبَةٍ وَثُقَبِ ٱلتُّرَابِ وَٱلصُّخُورِ.
verses.kjv: To dwell in the clifts of the valleys, [in] caves of the earth, and [in] the rocks.
verses.web: so that they live in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.

verses.ar: بَيْنَ ٱلشِّيحِ يَنْهَقُونَ. تَحْتَ ٱلْعَوْسَجِ يَنْكَبُّونَ.
verses.kjv: Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.
verses.web: They bray among the bushes. They are gathered together under the nettles.

verses.ar: أَبْنَاءُ ٱلْحَمَاقَةِ، بَلْ أَبْنَاءُ أُنَاسٍ بِلَا ٱسْمٍ، سِيطُوا مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: [They were] children of fools, yea, children of base men: they were viler than the earth.
verses.web: They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men. They were flogged out of the land.

verses.ar: «أَمَّا ٱلْآنَ فَصِرْتُ أُغْنِيَتَهُمْ، وَأَصْبَحْتُ لَهُمْ مَثَلًا!
verses.kjv: And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.
verses.web: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.

verses.ar: يَكْرَهُونَنِي. يَبْتَعِدُونَ عَنِّي، وَأَمَامَ وَجْهِي لَمْ يُمْسِكُوا عَنِ ٱلْبَصْقِ.
verses.kjv: They abhor me, they flee far from me, and spare not to spit in my face.
verses.web: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ أَطْلَقَ ٱلْعِنَانَ وَقَهَرَنِي، فَنَزَعُوا ٱلزِّمَامَ قُدَّامِي.
verses.kjv: Because he hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me, they have also let loose the bridle before me.
verses.web: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.

verses.ar: عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ ٱلْفُرُوخُ يَقُومُونَ يُزِيحُونَ رِجْلِي، وَيُعِدُّونَ عَلَيَّ طُرُقَهُمْ لِلْبَوَارِ.
verses.kjv: Upon [my] right [hand] rise the youth; they push away my feet, and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.
verses.web: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet. They cast their ways of destruction up against me.

verses.ar: أَفْسَدُوا سُبُلِي. أَعَانُوا عَلَى سُقُوطِي. لَا مُسَاعِدَ عَلَيْهِمْ.
verses.kjv: They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, they have no helper.
verses.web: They mar my path. They promote my destruction without anyone’s help.

verses.ar: يَأْتُونَ كَصَدْعٍ عَرِيضٍ. تَحْتَ ٱلْهَدَّةِ يَتَدَحْرَجُونَ.
verses.kjv: They came [upon me] as a wide breaking in [of waters:] in the desolation they rolled themselves [upon me].
verses.web: As through a wide breach they come. They roll themselves in amid the ruin.

verses.ar: اِنْقَلَبَتْ عَلَيَّ أَهْوَالٌ. طَرَدَتْ كَٱلرِّيحِ نِعْمَتِي، فَعَبَرَتْ كَٱلسَّحَابِ سَعَادَتِي.
verses.kjv: Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind: and my welfare passeth away as a cloud.
verses.web: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.

verses.ar: «فَٱلْآنَ ٱنْهَالَتْ نَفْسِي عَلَيَّ، وَأَخَذَتْنِي أَيَّامُ ٱلْمَذَلَّةِ.
verses.kjv: And now my soul is poured out upon me; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me.
verses.web: “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold of me.

verses.ar: ٱللَّيْلَ يَنْخَرُ عِظَامِي فِيَّ، وَعَارِقِيَّ لَا تَهْجَعُ.
verses.kjv: My bones are pierced in me in the night season: and my sinews take no rest.
verses.web: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.

verses.ar: بِكَثْرَةِ ٱلشِّدَّةِ تَنَكَّرَ لِبْسِي. مِثْلَ جَيْبِ قَمِيصِي حَزَمَتْنِي.
verses.kjv: By the great force [of my disease] is my garment changed: it bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.
verses.web: My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.

verses.ar: قَدْ طَرَحَنِي فِي ٱلْوَحْلِ، فَأَشْبَهْتُ ٱلتُّرَابَ وَٱلرَّمَادَ.
verses.kjv: He hath cast me into the mire, and I am become like dust and ashes.
verses.web: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.

verses.ar: إِلَيْكَ أَصْرُخُ فَمَا تَسْتَجِيبُ لِي. أَقُومُ فَمَا تَنْتَبِهُ إِلَيَّ.
verses.kjv: I cry unto thee, and thou dost not hear me: I stand up, and thou regardest me [not].
verses.web: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.

verses.ar: تَحَوَّلْتَ إِلَى جَافٍ مِنْ نَحْوِي. بِقُدْرَةِ يَدِكَ تَضْطَهِدُنِي.
verses.kjv: Thou art become cruel to me: with thy strong hand thou opposest thyself against me.
verses.web: You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.

verses.ar: حَمَلْتَنِي، أَرْكَبْتَنِي ٱلرِّيحَ وَذَوَّبْتَنِي تَشَوُّهًا.
verses.kjv: Thou liftest me up to the wind; thou causest me to ride [upon it], and dissolvest my substance.
verses.web: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.

verses.ar: لِأَنِّي أَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ إِلَى ٱلْمَوْتِ تُعِيدُنِي، وَإِلَى بَيْتِ مِيعَادِ كُلِّ حَيٍّ.
verses.kjv: For I know [that] thou wilt bring me [to] death, and [to] the house appointed for all living.
verses.web: For I know that you will bring me to death, to the house appointed for all living.

verses.ar: وَلَكِنْ فِي ٱلْخَرَابِ أَلَا يَمُدُّ يَدًا؟ فِي ٱلْبَلِيَّةِ أَلَا يَسْتَغِيثُ عَلَيْهَا؟
verses.kjv: Howbeit he will not stretch out [his] hand to the grave, though they cry in his destruction.
verses.web: “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?

verses.ar: «أَلَمْ أَبْكِ لِمَنْ عَسَرَ يَوْمُهُ؟ أَلَمْ تَكْتَئِبْ نَفْسِي عَلَى ٱلْمِسْكِينِ؟
verses.kjv: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? was [not] my soul grieved for the poor?
verses.web: Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?

verses.ar: حِينَمَا تَرَجَّيْتُ ٱلْخَيْرَ جَاءَ ٱلشَّرُّ، وَٱنْتَظَرْتُ ٱلنُّورَ فَجَاءَ ٱلدُّجَى.
verses.kjv: When I looked for good, then evil came [unto me:] and when I waited for light, there came darkness.
verses.web: When I looked for good, then evil came. When I waited for light, darkness came.

verses.ar: أَمْعَائِي تَغْلِي وَلَا تَكُفُّ. تَقَدَّمَتْنِي أَيَّامُ ٱلْمَذَلَّةِ.
verses.kjv: My bowels boiled, and rested not: the days of affliction prevented me.
verses.web: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.

verses.ar: اِسْوَدَدْتُ لَكِنْ بِلَا شَمْسٍ. قُمْتُ فِي ٱلْجَمَاعَةِ أَصْرُخُ.
verses.kjv: I went mourning without the sun: I stood up, [and] I cried in the congregation.
verses.web: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.

verses.ar: صِرْتُ أَخًا لِلذِّئَابِ، وَصَاحِبًا لِرِئَالِ ٱلنَّعَامِ.
verses.kjv: I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls.
verses.web: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.

verses.ar: حَرِشَ جِلْدِي عَلَيَّ وَعِظَامِي ٱحْتَرَّتْ مِنَ ٱلْحَرَارَةِ فِيَّ.
verses.kjv: My skin is black upon me, and my bones are burned with heat.
verses.web: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.

verses.ar: صَارَ عُودِي لِلنَّوْحِ، وَمِزْمَارِي لِصَوْتِ ٱلْبَاكِينَ.
verses.kjv: My harp also is [turned] to mourning, and my organ into the voice of them that weep.
verses.web: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.
